description: This file defines the LinkDecoder interface and provides two anonymous implementations: TEXT_PROTOCOL_DECODER and VOID. It includes a method to unpack packets, used for decoding data within a communication protocol.

classes.name: LinkDecoder
classes.description: An interface for decoding data packets with a method to unpack the packet string.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Abstract method for unpacking a given packet string.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Implementation of unpack for TEXT_PROTOCOL_DECODER, which utilizes EngineState.unpackString.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Implementation of unpack for VOID, which returns the packet as-is.
